description: Search the Solinkify DataHub marketplace. Returns id, title, price (USD stablecoin), seller, category, and sales count. Datasets: buy with datahub_buy. API listings (kind "api"): the price is per request — access them by calling gate_fetch on their api_base_url.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Free-text filter matched against title, author, description, category and format. Omit to browse everything. Plain keywords work best; there is no query syntax.

name: datahub_search
